title: Ginataang Bilo-Bilo: Thai-Style Coconut Ball Dessert
description: A unique Thai-inspired dessert featuring bilo-bilo (mung bean balls) cooked in a rich coconut milk sauce, topped with crispy charred peanuts for added crunch.
instructions: Combine coconut milk, sugar, water, and pandan extract in a large saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add bilo-bilo to the coconut milk mixture and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Transfer the dessert to individual serving bowls.
Garnish with charred peanuts and serve warm.
Serve with a side of ice cream or whipped cream, if desired.
